novelty_scope: Newly surfaced or elaborated for this dossier; first-in-literature novelty is unassessed.

items.title: Make every cheaper representation carry a recovery contract
items.mechanism: Join the fidelity ladder, archived spans and receipt compiler. A transformation records parent content IDs, recipe/version, permitted loss, expected recovery procedure and the check that establishes task-appropriate equivalence.
items.new_in_this_synthesis: The source already joins DERIVE to verification. This synthesis makes that interface reusable across parser indices, summaries and caches while retaining distinct equivalence rules for each.
items.novelty_class: Extension of an explicit source connection.
items.novelty_scope: Candidate connection for this dossier; not a first-in-literature claim. Some precursors may be explicit elsewhere in the supplied corpus.
items.why_useful: Memory savings become accountable transformations. A failed or unavailable reconstruction can be surfaced before it is silently treated as the original evidence.
items.discriminating_test: For the same task set, compare retain-exact, retain-recipe and retain-summary-plus-pointer. Plant a changed recipe and a missing parent. Charge rebuilding and verification to the saving.
items.prediction: For some reproducible artifacts, recipe storage should reduce residency while preserving required results; the detector should reject stale recipes. Approximate summaries need separate semantic checks.
items.change_mind: The retained information is insufficient to reconstruct the object, or total cost at matched quality is worse than the simpler policy.
items.execution_status: Design sketch only; not a sealed or executed study.

items.title: Separate an idea’s storage state, truth status and permission to act
items.mechanism: Represent three independent attributes: residency (hot/cold/recipe/unavailable), evidential status (Supported/Disputed/Unproven with scope), and permitted use (explore/advice/action under an actual policy).
items.new_in_this_synthesis: AUDIT/BELIEF/HEAD and dormancy are already present. The connection makes their different state transitions explicit: eviction does not refute; popularity does not verify; support does not authorize.
items.novelty_class: Operational separation of existing ideas; not a new theory of memory.
items.novelty_scope: Candidate connection for this dossier; not a first-in-literature claim. Some precursors may be explicit elsewhere in the supplied corpus.
items.why_useful: It protects speculative ideas from an execution gate and protects execution from speculative ideas. A cheap dormant hypothesis can remain available without entering active doctrine.
items.discriminating_test: Use a factorial fixture: supported-but-cold, unproven-but-hot, retracted-but-retrievable, expired-but-once-supported, and supported-but-unauthorized. Test retrieval and action decisions separately.
items.prediction: The factored state should reduce category errors relative to one undifferentiated active/inactive flag.
items.change_mind: Existing simpler fields already distinguish all cases reliably, or the additional state transitions produce more errors than they remove.
items.execution_status: Design sketch only; not a sealed or executed study.

items.title: Use game variants to generate bounded tests of agent authority and recovery
items.mechanism: Treat a ruleset as a generator of explicit states, legal moves, visibility boundaries and outcome checks. The same narrow fixture can test hidden information, revocation, duplicate submission, delayed observation and ordered replay.
items.new_in_this_synthesis: The earlier brief already names games as a testbed. The proposed bridge is a shared fixture with separate receiver, knowledge and passport measurements, rather than separate toy demonstrations.
items.novelty_class: More concrete joint test design for an existing connection.
items.novelty_scope: Candidate connection for this dossier; not a first-in-literature claim. Some precursors may be explicit elsewhere in the supplied corpus.
items.why_useful: A disagreement about a move has a bounded answer under a chosen rule version, making some coordination and recovery failures observable without a general language-model judge.
items.discriminating_test: Freeze one small ruleset and separate its oracle from the worker. Inject reordered and duplicate moves, stale turns and hidden observations. Compare the same-model naive loop with the fleet at matched budget.
items.prediction: Failures should localize to rule interpretation, information access or effect handling. A system that only narrates correct play will fail the receiver-based checks.
items.change_mind: Oracle and worker share an error, selected games do not exercise the intended property, or success does not transfer to a held-out game. Passing never establishes general real-world competence.
items.execution_status: Design sketch only; not a sealed or executed study.

items.title: Choose additional agents by measured rescue value and information access
items.mechanism: Combine behavioral passports with a table of paired failures and which observations each worker can obtain. Estimate the incremental value of a specialist conditional on the current worker failing, then test a selector on unseen tasks.
items.new_in_this_synthesis: This replaces the strong basis/rank analogy with a concrete selection target and separates model diversity from sensor or evidence diversity.
items.novelty_class: Operational reformulation of existing complementarity ideas.
items.novelty_scope: Candidate connection for this dossier; not a first-in-literature claim. Some precursors may be explicit elsewhere in the supplied corpus.
items.why_useful: It can identify a valuable cheap specialist or missing observation without assuming that a different persona, architecture or provider is independent.
items.discriminating_test: Compare another sample from the same model, a different model with the same evidence, and the same model with an additional relevant observation. Train selection only on earlier tasks.
items.prediction: Some apparent model-diversity gains may be explained by additional evidence or retry budget; remaining held-out rescue value is the quantity to route on.
items.change_mind: The selector cannot predict rescue opportunities, the apparent benefit leaks across train/test families, or ordinary retries match it at equal cost.
items.execution_status: Design sketch only; not a sealed or executed study.

items.title: Let the next decision guide both information retrieval and human escalation
items.mechanism: Use an explicit upcoming decision as the shared reference for what to retrieve, what to prefetch and what to put in the operator’s review queue. Keep uncertainty about that decision and a route for unexpected observations.
items.new_in_this_synthesis: The corpus already has decision-linked reports, query-aware rendering and cost-aware routing. Their joint budget is proposed here: compute time and operator attention both spent on information that could change a decision.
items.novelty_class: Cross-section synthesis; occurrence elsewhere and external novelty unassessed.
items.novelty_scope: Candidate connection for this dossier; not a first-in-literature claim. Some precursors may be explicit elsewhere in the supplied corpus.
items.why_useful: It gives the broad rendering metaphor a concrete target while making the operator’s review cost visible.
items.discriminating_test: Compare recency-based retrieval and an ordinary inbox with decision-guided retrieval and grouping. Inject a relevant surprise not named in the current plan. Record task quality, reading time, late decisions and suppressed alarms.
items.prediction: Routine traffic may decrease, but any gain must survive the surprise condition and include the cost of maintaining decision annotations.
items.change_mind: The filter systematically hides unanticipated facts or annotation overhead exceeds the saved effort. Fewer alerts alone is not success.
items.execution_status: Design sketch only; not a sealed or executed study.

items.title: A retraction should invalidate dependent products, not merely edit a sentence
items.mechanism: Connect receipt dependencies to derived summaries, cached answers, passport scores and inherited lessons. When a premise changes, mark the affected products as requiring review or recomputation; preserve unrelated products and the historical record.
items.new_in_this_synthesis: The source already calls for dependency invalidation. The extension traces that obligation across memory, routing and next-generation prompts, with different handling for hard dependencies and merely suggestive citations.
items.novelty_scope: Candidate connection for this dossier; not a first-in-literature claim. Some precursors may be explicit elsewhere in the supplied corpus.
items.why_useful: A corrected ledger can otherwise coexist with an old answer still circulating through the fleet. The target is measured correction propagation.
items.discriminating_test: Plant one false premise, create known descendants in several stores, then retract it. Include an unaffected control and a disputed but not disproven premise. Measure stale-use rate, recovery time and unnecessary invalidation.
items.prediction: Explicit dependency lineage should shorten propagation and reduce recurrence, provided important dependencies are captured and retraction authority is constrained.
items.change_mind: Dependencies are too incomplete, contested retractions cause excessive shutdown, or a simpler version reset achieves comparable outcomes with less burden.
items.execution_status: Design sketch only; not a sealed or executed study.

items.title: Historical game variants can test whether dissent survives compaction
items.mechanism: Carry two internally coherent rule reconstructions with distinct provenance through retrieval, salon synthesis and a context fold. Then ask a later model to run the variant selected by the user and explain which alternative remains unresolved.
items.new_in_this_synthesis: This connects the preservation ambition to an observable dissent-retention task. Historical truth is not decided by game outcomes; the test concerns faithful preservation of alternatives.
items.novelty_scope: Candidate connection for this dossier; not a first-in-literature claim. Some precursors may be explicit elsewhere in the supplied corpus.
items.why_useful: Compaction can be evaluated for premature agreement rather than only average fact recall. A minority variant has a concrete downstream consequence.
items.discriminating_test: Begin with synthetic variants whose rule differences are known; later use a historically sourced case. Compare ordinary summary, branch-preserving summary and source-linked retrieval at equal budget.
items.prediction: A branch-preserving representation should reduce accidental hybrid rules and loss of the requested variant.
items.change_mind: Ordinary summaries perform equally well, branches create excessive retrieval confusion, or source labels silently bias the grader.
items.execution_status: Design sketch only; not a sealed or executed study.

items.title: The model passport can become an interface for measured stochastic services
items.mechanism: Define an organ by input/output contract, output distribution or tolerance, calibration conditions and total cost. A language model, simulator and physical sampler could share parts of this interface without being interchangeable.
items.new_in_this_synthesis: The atlas and the physical dialogue already use distributional measurement. The connection asks which fields are common and which must remain domain-specific.
items.novelty_class: Interface hypothesis joining two existing branches.
items.novelty_scope: Candidate connection for this dossier; not a first-in-literature claim. Some precursors may be explicit elsewhere in the supplied corpus.
items.why_useful: It can preserve the physical-computing idea as a bounded research lane instead of using it as proof of fleet efficiency or discarding it as metaphor.
items.discriminating_test: Write a task contract for a small sampling problem, validate a digital reference, and test whether a second service can satisfy the same acceptance rule. Evaluate hardware only when actual measurements are available.
items.prediction: Some verification and cost fields may transfer; model-specific semantics, correlated samples and calibration drift will limit the shared contract.
items.change_mind: The common schema hides the properties that decide task quality, or a nominal efficiency gain disappears after full interface costs.
items.execution_status: Design sketch only; not a sealed or executed study.

items.title: Compare a source-first reading with a map-first reading before the next fold
items.mechanism: Two isolated workers examine the same bounded question. One starts with a sealed source pack; the other with the current map plus that pack. Both commit candidate mechanisms, evidence and tests before seeing the other response. Then reconcile differences by source and executable consequence.
items.new_in_this_synthesis: Fresh-instance and contamination concerns are already explicit. This turns the dossier itself into an experimental input and makes editorial selection a measured variable.
items.novelty_class: Concrete protocol sketch from existing anti-capture proposals.
items.novelty_scope: Candidate connection for this dossier; not a first-in-literature claim. Some precursors may be explicit elsewhere in the supplied corpus.
items.why_useful: It can reveal what the map helps a reader find and what it makes harder to notice. Useful convergence and useful disagreement can both survive.
items.discriminating_test: Randomize presentation order across multiple matched tasks and fresh sessions; hold total evidence and budget constant. Blind a third-stage rubric to arm labels. With only two workers on one task, report a case comparison, not a causal effect estimate.
items.prediction: Map-first should save orientation time but may narrow candidate mechanisms. Count validated recoveries and supported omissions, not just different wording or disagreement.
items.change_mind: Source-first produces no distinct checkable gain, or its cost exceeds the benefit. Same-model isolated workers still have correlated priors.
items.execution_status: Design sketch only; not a sealed or executed study.

items.title: Ask whether assistance leaves the operator better able to act independently
items.mechanism: Pair immediate task completion with a later unassisted transfer task and a practical exit exercise. The game or repair environment supplies observable outcomes; the operator’s own goals define which abilities matter.
items.new_in_this_synthesis: The corpus proposes sovereignty capacities and exit rights. This connection adds a delayed outcome to distinguish assistance that teaches or preserves control from assistance that only completes the present task.
items.novelty_class: Candidate evaluation bridge; not a validated general agency measure.
items.novelty_scope: Candidate connection for this dossier; not a first-in-literature claim. Some precursors may be explicit elsewhere in the supplied corpus.
items.why_useful: It takes the operator-centered aim seriously without substituting a model’s flattering assessment of the operator for observed ability.
items.discriminating_test: Compare terse answers, explanations and interactive scaffolding on matched task families. Counterbalance order and record prior skill; later test transfer, correction and export/restart. Treat one-operator results as a case study.
items.prediction: Some styles may cost more immediately while improving later independent performance; others may create extra burden without transfer.
items.change_mind: No delayed benefit appears, the exercises measure the wrong capacity, or the operator prefers a different tradeoff. Independence is not a mandatory objective for every delegated task.
items.execution_status: Design sketch only; not a sealed or executed study.
